concept: Continuing to sharpen a professional skill years into mastering it, rather than coasting on existing competence
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult with years of experience in their craft could easily coast, but a genuine opportunity to sharpen further exists
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does continued mastery look like once you're already considered good at something?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific, real way to keep sharpening their craft

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific practice or challenge, not a vague intention to 'keep learning'
